@[elab_as_elim]
protected lemma ind_on_depth (P : Term Var → Prop) (bvar : ∀ i, P (bvar i)) (fvar : ∀ x, P (fvar x))
    (app : ∀ M N, P M → P N → P (app M N))
    (abs : ∀ M, P M → (∀ N, N.depth ≤ M.depth → P N) → P M.abs)
    (M : Term Var) : P M :=
proof_text:
by
  induction h : M.depth using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing M with | _ n ih
  induction M with
  | abs M' => apply abs M' <;> grind
  | _ => grind [sup_le_iff]
gold_proof:
by
  induction h : M.depth using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing M with | _ n ih
  induction M with
  | abs M' => apply abs M' <;> grind
  | _ => grind [sup_le_iff]

theorem lcAt_iff_LC (M : Term Var) [HasFresh Var] : LcAt 0 M ↔ M.LC :=
proof_text:
by
  induction M using LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.ind_on_depth with
    | abs =>
      constructor
      · grind [LC.abs ∅]
      · intros h2
        rcases h2 with ⟨⟩|⟨L,_,_⟩
        grind [fresh_exists L]
    | _ => grind [cases LC]
gold_proof:
by
  induction M using LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.ind_on_depth with
    | abs =>
      constructor
      · grind [LC.abs ∅]
      · intros h2
        rcases h2 with ⟨⟩|⟨L,_,_⟩
        grind [fresh_exists L]
    | _ => grind [cases LC]

lemma orth_iUnion {ι : Sort*} (G : ι → Set P) :
    (⋃ i, G i)⫠ = ⋂ i, (G i)⫠ :=
proof_text:
by
  ext m; constructor
  · intro hm
    have hm' : ∀ x ∈ ⋃ j, G j, m * x ∈ PhaseSpace.bot := by grind
    refine mem_iInter.mpr (fun i => ?_)
    exact fun x hx => hm' x (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hx⟩)
  · intro hm x hx
    rcases mem_iUnion.mp hx with ⟨i, hix⟩
    have hmi : m ∈ (G i)⫠ := mem_iInter.mp hm i
    grind
gold_proof:
by
  ext m; constructor
  · intro hm
    have hm' : ∀ x ∈ ⋃ j, G j, m * x ∈ PhaseSpace.bot := by grind
    refine mem_iInter.mpr (fun i => ?_)
    exact fun x hx => hm' x (mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hx⟩)
  · intro hm x hx
    rcases mem_iUnion.mp hx with ⟨i, hix⟩
    have hmi : m ∈ (G i)⫠ := mem_iInter.mp hm i
    grind
